cleaning_decisions.cleaning_rationale: Removed 1 exact duplicate pair and 6 contradictory pairs (12 rows) where conflicting human annotators assigned different labels (e.g. Good Fit vs No Fit) to identical resume-job pairs.

split_1_jd_held_out.description: Standard split holding out 71 job descriptions; resumes overlap between train and test.

split_2_resume_held_out.description: Strict identity-aware split holding out 128 unique resumes with zero resume leakage.

split_3_combined_generalization.description: Strict bipartite hold-out with unseen resumes AND unseen job descriptions.
split_3_combined_generalization.limitations: Smaller test sample size (350 pairs) due to bipartite graph sparsity, but provides 100% zero-leakage evaluation.
